newsitem.title: USA: Oakley chairman to buy up to one million shares.
newsitem.headline: Oakley chairman to buy up to one million shares.

text.p: Oakley Inc said Chairman and President Jim Jannard has advised the company he intends to purchase up to approximately one million shares of Oakley stock from time to time in the open market, subject to market conditions.
The purchase of one million shares would increase his ownership stake to just over 50 percent, the company said.

"Based on the fundamental strengths of the company and our long-term growth prospects, I believe Oakley's stock is substantially undervalued and, at current market prices, represents a very attractive investment opportunity," Jannard said.
The company's stock was up 1/4 to 11-1/4, off its 52-week high of 27-1/8.
